title: KV slot fairness and batch-coalescing allocation strategy to reduce fragmentation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: As continuous batching increases throughput, KV allocations from many overlapping requests create fine-grained fragmentation in GPU-resident KV pools. This causes elevated memory pressure for long-running models and spikes in allocation latency during compaction windows. Goal: introduce a KV allocation strategy that enforces slot fairness across active batch windows, coalesces short-lived allocations aligned with batch boundaries, and provides background soft-compaction to reclaim fragmentation without impacting tail latency.
technical_design: 1) Batch-coalescing allocator: allocate KV slots in 'batch epochs' (configurable window 10-200ms). Within an epoch, small allocations are placed into epoch-local arenas to encourage contiguous placement. Epoch arenas are promoted to regular pools after a TTL if they outlive the epoch. 2) Slot fairness policy: limit per-request reservation fraction to avoid single-heavy requests monopolizing contiguous ranges; implement proportional share based on request token count and priority tier. 3) Soft-pinning / hot token lanes: heavily reused KV entries are soft-pinned into hot lanes with larger slab sizes to reduce churn; cold entries go into compacting lanes. 4) Background micro-compaction: opportunistic compact/relocate tasks run when GPU utilization < threshold and latency SLO headroom exists; compaction operates at arena granularity to avoid inner-loop stalls. 5) Allocation simulation: extend existing memory simulator to model epoch arenas, per-request share, and compaction latency; simulate mixed workloads (chatty short-turn, long-context embeddings) to tune epoch TTL and slab sizes.
acceptance_criteria:
- New allocator can be enabled behind feature flag with no changes to API.
- Under synthetic mixed workload, fragmentation metric (token-residency-entropy) improves by >=25% at steady state.
- 95th percentile tail latency for allocation path not increased by >5% during normal traffic.
- Background compaction runs only when GPU utilization < configured threshold and completes relocations without OOMs.
- Telemetry dashboards show per-epoch allocation histograms and compaction events.
rollout_plan:
- Stage 1 (dev cluster): implement feature-flagged allocator and simulator, unit tests, and local benchmarks. (2 weeks)
- Stage 2 (staging): run canary with 5% traffic on non-critical models; collect fragmentation and tail latency metrics for two weeks. (1 week)
- Stage 3 (gradual ramp): enable for low-priority Dedicated pools with auto-roll back on observed QoS regressions; run compaction with conservative thresholds. (2 weeks)
- Stage 4 (full): after stability and metric targets met, roll to default for selected instance types and publish config knobs in Console. (1 week)
telemetry_and_observability:
- New metrics: epoch_alloc_count, epoch_alloc_bytes, per_epoch_fragmentation_score, compaction_relocations, compaction_duration_ms, hot_lane_hit_rate.
- Dashboards: per-model fragmentation heatmap, epoch length distribution, allocation contiguity ratio.
- Alerts: sustained per_epoch_fragmentation_score > threshold for 5m, compaction_relocation_rate > X and GPU memory pressure > Y.
- Add tracing spans for allocation decisions to correlate with request traces.
risks_and_mitigation:
- Risk: aggressive compaction may cause CPU/GPU contention and increase tail latency. Mitigation: compaction gate using utilization SLO and gradual backoff.
- Risk: feature flag regression could expose regressions on multi-tenant Dedicated pools. Mitigation: default to conservative limits and enable only on pools with reserve headroom; phased rollout.
- Risk: incorrect per-request share could starve high-priority tenants. Mitigation: expose priority weight config and enforce min guaranteed contiguous reservation for P0 lanes.
implementation_tasks:
- Prototype epoch arena allocator and epoch boundary coordination.
- Integrate per-request share enforcement and priority weights.
- Implement hot/cold lane assignment and promotion heuristics.
- Add background micro-compactor with utilization gating.
- Extend simulator and run benchmarks with representative workloads.
- Add telemetry, dashboards, and alerts.
- Write migration docs and Console knobs for operators.
